description: Send a transactional email without waiting for the delivery outcome. The call hands the email to the sending provider and returns a `message_id` with `status: sent` once the provider has accepted it (`scheduled` when send_at is set); whether it reached the inbox is reported later — read it with truncus_get_email or truncus_list_events. Use this for fire-and-forget transactional sends (welcomes, receipts, password resets). For synchronous delivery confirmation use truncus_send_sync. The `from` address must be on a verified Truncus domain — list yours with truncus_list_domains.

from.description: Sender address. Must match a verified Truncus domain.

html.description: HTML body. Required unless template_id is provided.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Stable key tied to your business event (e.g. order-1234-receipt). Omit it and the server derives one deterministically from this call's arguments, so an identical retry is recognised as a duplicate and never sends twice. Supply your own when the same message may be built from differing arguments.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata stored with the email record.

send_at.description: ISO 8601 future datetime to schedule delivery (e.g. 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z).

template_id.description: Saved template ID. Mutually exclusive with html.

tenant_id.description: Isolate suppression lists per tenant in multi-tenant applications.

name: truncus_send
title: Send a transactional email
